value: 133% of FPL plus the standard 5-percentage-point-of-FPL disregard = 138%
detail: CRS Report R48755: 'The upper income-eligibility threshold associated with the ACA Medicaid expansion population... is 133% of the FPL (or 138% of the FPL with the application of a standard 5-percentage-point-of-FPL income disregard).' 42 CFR 435.603(d)(4) requires the state to subtract an amount equivalent to 5 percentage points of FPL for the applicable family size, only to determine eligibility for the group with the highest income standard using MAGI-based methodologies.
notes: Arithmetic check: 133% of the 2026 guideline of $15,960 is $21,226.80; adding the 5-point disregard gives $22,025, the DHCS chart figure for a household of one.
